description: Panel listing compliance screening findings for one subject — category, severity badge, source, time and a confidence meter — ordered pending-first, then by severity and recency. Reviewers confirm a finding as a true hit or dismiss it as a false positive (optionally with a note) through IScreeningProvider; the resolution note, reviewer and timestamp render on resolved findings. Supports a read-only mode and an empty state.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Data source of the findings and the resolution workflow. Required.

parameters.name: SubjectId
parameters.description: Identifier of the screened subject. Required.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Hides the confirm/dismiss actions when true. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowConfidence
parameters.description: Whether the confidence indicator is shown. Default is true.

parameters.name: OnFindingResolved
parameters.description: Callback invoked after a finding was confirmed or dismissed.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
